subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should the standalone TUI stop at documenting its existing Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J behavior, or also integrate the existing agent-session keybinding manager for configurable submit/newline bindings?
rationale: The default multiline capability already exists upstream, but making standalone TUI bindings persistent and configurable establishes a new public product and ownership contract.

options.title: Document Existing Keys
options.body: Add docs and in-product shortcut help for Enter, Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and terminal limitations without adding configuration.

options.title: Share Keybinding Manager
options.body: Wire standalone TUI input to the existing per-agent keybinding manager and document one canonical configuration contract.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Keys
recommendation.body: Add docs and in-product shortcut help for Enter, Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, and terminal limitations without adding configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing evidence combines the prior explicit issue review with repeated recent ownership of standalone TUI and documentation surfaces.
